desc: Prove the adjacent-removal/non-crossing matching characterization, with the constraint that an unremoved singleton cannot be enclosed by a pair.
Prove the even-segment optimum is the difference between the sums of its largest and smallest half of values, including ties and constructive attainability.
Derive and validate the correct odd-\(N\) split-at-singleton formulation and the \(O(N\log N)\) prefix/suffix heap algorithm.
Cross-check the formula against the public samples.
Specify Python implementation details, including heap balancing, sum maintenance, and stdout format.
